intro: Three attempts to intervene, three outcomes, and a rule about the third.

steps.caption: Attempt 1 reaches the world and is applied.
Attempt 2 is refused, by name. Refusal is an outcome, not an error path.
steps.takeaway: APPLIED and REFUSED are both settled facts about an attempt.

steps.caption: Attempt 3 times out. The request is abandoned — the work is not. Did it apply? Unknown.
INDETERMINATE. It is a fact about an attempt, and it is never rewritten — not when the work later lands, not when it later fails.
steps.takeaway: INDETERMINATE is a fact about an attempt. It is never rewritten.

steps.caption: The same document that specifies this refutes its predecessor's settle-in-place design: the ledger has no update-in-place. A pattern and its own review in one file.
steps.takeaway: A timeout is not a death: a witness is sound after a death and unsound after a timeout.
